snippet.title: Hardkill System - Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520750/Hardkill_System
Support the development: https://buymeacoffee.com/yevhenbodrenko

Take control of a powerful mech, scavenge for different weapons and upgrades, and complete missions to help the last humans recover from the AI apocalypse in this top-down real-time tactical action-roguelite.
